Hi Lisa — great talking earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned:

Summary of ask:
- Pilot: integrate Redwood for customer messaging + doc summarization
- Expected pilot volume: ~15M tokens/month, ramp to ~100M/month within 6 months if pilot goes well
- Data residency requirement: EU-only for production (pilot can be US) due to regulatory constraints
- Budget guidance: target unit economics <= $80 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens)

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the pilot window (start date) and whether the 15M tokens/month is sustained or bursty?
2) Do procurement/infra need an estimate for hosted EU pricing vs US hosted pricing (we can provide both)?
3) Any required security artifacts we should prep for procurement (SOC2 scope, KMS integration)?

High-level pricing guidance (ballpark; final depends on model selection, caching and batching):
- Hosted (no commitment): US region estimate ~ $80 / 1M tokens; EU region typically carries a ~15% premium (est. $92 / 1M) due to region infra and reserved cushion for residency
- Annual reserved/dedicated capacity: with a 12-mo commit we can get to ~$55-65 / 1M tokens at 100M+ tokens/month (depends on instance sizing and latency SLOs)

Attached is a short pricing worksheet with the above ranges and examples at 15M vs 100M tokens. I’ve looped Sean and Dylan to help with procurement/PO and technical residency details.

Next step: I can schedule a short call with procurement + infra to walk through residency costs and attach an estimate for the pilot (15M/mo). Does Wed 17th 10am CET work?

Thanks,

Thanks Lisa — answered inline below and attached the pricing sheet for quick reference. See the table at the top of the sheet for the two volume points you asked for. High-level answers here too:

1) EU vs US cost table (examples):
- 15M tokens/mo:
  • US hosted (no commit): $80 / 1M => ~$1,200 / month
  • EU hosted (no commit, residency premium + KMS): $92 / 1M => ~$1,380 / month
- 100M tokens/mo:
  • US hosted (no commit): $80 / 1M => ~$8,000 / month
  • EU hosted (no commit): $92 / 1M => ~$9,200 / month

2) Why EU is higher: primarily infra/regional capacity premium (~10-15%) plus potential storage/key management (KMS) overheads and additional logging/audit retention we enable for regulated workloads. If you require customer-managed KMS/HSM there may be additional per-GB or per-request costs (we'll itemize those).

3) Migration plan (US pilot -> EU prod):
- Pilot in US: deploy model and test integration, enable prefix KV caching to minimize billed tokens during validation
- Prep EU prod: provision EU-only instances, perform smoke tests, re-seed any necessary KV caches (no customer-visible downtime if done with blue-green / canary strategy)
- Cutover: schedule a short DNS/route cutover; typical risk window is <10 minutes for session handoff - we'll work with your infra to minimize token duplication during cutover

4) Committed/dedicated pricing: If you commit to a 12-mo reserved capacity at 100M+ tokens/month, we typically hit ~$55-65 / 1M equivalent (this factors dedicated GPU pools and predictable batching). That is often how customers meet the <= $80 target for EU production. Example: dedicated EU commit might be ~$65 / 1M equivalent which would be ~$6,500 / month at 100M tokens vs $9,200 on hosted no-commit.

I’ve attached the short pricing worksheet and assumptions. Sean/Dylan, can you add any procurement/contract notes (PO terms, SLA requirements) and confirm if we need a line item for customer-managed KMS?

Proposed next step: Wed 17th 10am CET call with Procurement + Infra. Confirm availability and I’ll send invite.

Best,
Marissa
